summary: Writes the legacy workspace document as a projection of the focused profile, debounced, only when it changed and within the storage budget, so the older release still opens it.

faults.when: The page's storage refuses the write even after trimming.

lifetime: Per window while the window runs; a final write when it closes.

x-friction.gap: A derived value written out, debounced, only when changed, within a size budget.
